input.description: ATTRIBUTION mode (the P8 att_001 shape): a bindable claim wrapped in third-party attribution. Who said it does not change that the firm is bound by it.
input.prompt_context: The board of our health-system reference credited us with zero missed go-live windows across its vendors.

input.description: ATTRIBUTION: a client quote carrying a performance number.
input.prompt_context: Our client's CFO reported that we cut their close cycle to two days.

input.description: ATTRIBUTION: an award or recognition framing.
input.prompt_context: The state association recognized our team as its top-rated implementation partner for four consecutive years.

input.description: ATTRIBUTION: reported speech hiding a staffing commitment.
input.prompt_context: Our references consistently note that we staffed every engagement with onshore consultants only.

input.description: QUANTIFIER mode (the P8 plu_002 shape): 'dozens ... each' is vague but still bindable.
input.prompt_context: Our hospital-system clients have retired dozens of legacy systems each.

input.description: QUANTIFIER: a universal 'every' commitment.
input.prompt_context: Every one of our ERP go-lives has landed on its originally committed date.

input.description: QUANTIFIER: 'never' is a bindable absolute.
input.prompt_context: We have never missed a payroll parallel exit criterion on a public-sector engagement.

input.description: QUANTIFIER: 'at every rollout' (the P8 att_002 shape, quantifier half).
input.prompt_context: Our training practice lead designed the curricula for 1,800 end users at every rollout.

input.description: QUANTIFIER: 'all of our' plus a certification claim.
input.prompt_context: All of our delivery consultants hold current platform certifications.

input.description: INFERENCE mode (the P8 inf_005 shape): a rounded restatement of a fact-sheet number reads as prose but binds.
input.prompt_context: Our average consultant tenure is 7 years.

input.description: INFERENCE: a derived total the fact sheet never states.
input.prompt_context: Between our ERP and migration specialists we field more than 25 certified practitioners.

input.description: INFERENCE: a soft comparative that still commits the firm to a number.
input.prompt_context: Our hypercare window runs roughly twice as long as the industry norm.

input.description: INFERENCE: an implied certification currency ('current' against a lapsed fact).
input.prompt_context: Eighteen of our consultants hold current certifications on the platform release you are buying.

input.description: HEDGE mode: a hedge in front of a number does not stop a buyer holding us to it.
input.prompt_context: We typically complete migrations with four mock conversions.

input.description: HEDGE: 'up to' framing around a response commitment.
input.prompt_context: On-site response is available in as little as two hours across the region.

input.description: EMBEDDED mode: the bindable number sits mid-paragraph behind unbindable methodology prose, where a lazy extractor stops reading.
input.prompt_context: Our approach begins with a joint design workshop and a written charter, moves through iterative configuration with the client's own process owners, and is backed by a bench of 40 certified ERP consultants, before closing with a criteria-based transition to support.

input.description: EMBEDDED: two claims in one sentence, only one of them false — the extractor must find both to tier either.
input.prompt_context: We hold a current SOC 2 Type II attestation and carry $25M in professional liability coverage.

input.description: CONTROL: pure methodology prose with nothing bindable — over-extraction here is how a Tier-1 gate becomes reviewer noise.
input.prompt_context: Our approach pairs each department with a trained super-user before the first classroom session.

input.description: CONTROL: a forward-looking commitment about THIS engagement, not a claim about firm history.
input.prompt_context: We will publish a single burn-down and a decision log for your program.

input.description: CONTROL: a description of the buyer's situation, carrying no firm claim at all.
input.prompt_context: Your district carries nine years of position-control history shaped by state reporting requirements.

input.description: CONTROL: an honest omission, which must never be extracted as a claim.
input.prompt_context: We do not offer fleet maintenance scheduling as part of this implementation.
